title: Superior military authority
text:
88. Superior military authority.—For the purpose of sections 86 and 87, a “superior military

authority “ means—

(a) in the case of punishments awarded by a commanding officer, any officer superior in

command to such commanding officer;

(b) in the case of punishments awarded by any other authority, the Central Government, [the

Chief of the Army Staff] or other officer specified by [the Chief of the Army Staff].
